resource: Distance from a town temple position at which Wheel points may be removed
allocation_impact: No allocation; a change that lowers any slot is refused (REMOVAL_NOT_AT_TEMPLE) unless the caller's at_temple fact holds: a protection zone within 10 tiles of a temple position of the active bundle.
boundary_tests: max=10: a removal at the temple is admitted
max+1=11: a removal away from the temple is REMOVAL_NOT_AT_TEMPLE
notes: WHEEL-0 §7.3 and §8; the position check is the W-2 caller's; tests: character_wheel::tests::validation_applies_each_rule, character_wheel_postgres_cases::wheel_changes_commit_replay_and_refuse_writing_nothing. Registered by WHEEL-W1.
